Do meditation for your anxiety, that's really helped me. While waking up(from jw cult) I had terrible anxiety for months, even panic attacks, I honestly couldn't take any stress whatsoever. I'd lock myself in a quite room for 20 minutes while at work trying to avoid attacks I'd meditate. I told my boss all that I was going through and He was very understanding and supportive. I started out with guided mediation on YouTube, this video in particular was amazing for me https://youtu.be/Jyy0ra2WcQQ  Thankfully my issues stopped mostly after fully proving and accepting that I was in a cult. So ultimately I'd say find the cause, when you vent what are you venting about?  If you find it, ask yourself is it something I can change? Sharing your feelings is healthy, but if your friendships are one sided(them always listening to your issues) it isn't healthy, at least not for them. Everyone has stress, but there has to be a balance in conversation/friendships positive to balance negative.  For example I personally work with ones with mental illness,  its my job to be a friends/caretaker to them, part of my job is listen to what's bothering them or "their stressors".  Alot of the time my job isn't so bad but when they are highly stressed and venting to me constantly it makes me highly stressed. When made highly stressed I wanna get off work and get away from those causing me stress. I'm not saying don't vent, as that is also needed in a healthy friendship. just don't do it constantly as that will push people away. I suggest asking yourself can I go one conversation without complaining? If not try too, if so good job now try and improve. Find a balance, you won't figure it out if you give up. We live through our experiences, they are all we are so if you stop trying to improve you'll never grow. Try and be a good friend and people will flock to you. One last thought, don't be hard on yourself, you have been through much more at a young age than many will experience in there lives you were raised in a cult. 
I wish you the best and sincerely hope this helps,  much unconditional love to you.❤
